about: Endep (amitriptyline) 25 mg, TWO tablets at night (50 mg a day), and Atacand (candesartan, lowers blood pressure) are both supplied monthly by brand name only to a 70-year-old.
In this 73-year-old, Allegron 25 mg prescribed as two tablets nightly overlaps Minax during a short episode, with separate Minax supplies early and late in the history.
Endep (amitriptyline) is supplied as a 10 mg tablet, ONE at night (10 mg a day), which is under 50 mg a day, so it does not meet the criterion even with Minax (metoprolol).
